inspected_anchors.finding: This source header grants GPL version 3 or later; distribution and dependency review remain necessary.
The documented target is a supplied pure latent measurement model; the class is package-private.
estimate creates a SemIm, estimates coefficients and returns it; getEstimatedSem returns that object.
Default fixed-loading selection uses lexicographic indicator names; explicit fixed-loading names are another branch.
Other measurements of latent parents supply instrument columns; an empty instrument collection skips that latent iteration.
Projection uses two direct inverses; the covariance helper is called only for a matching selected nodeName.
Measurement iteration excludes the current and fixed indicator, then skips when no other measures remain.
C is populated with getDouble(colIndex, i), reversing the declared case/variable argument order.
Nearby V and outcome reads use row then column; a scalar inverse projected norm supplies the loading estimate.
A residual-variance-scaled inverse is computed into a local array in a void helper, with no return or field assignment.
getDouble specifies row as case and column as variable.
The array inverse delegates to Matrix.inverse().
inverse checks square/zero dimensions then calls CommonOps_DDRM.invert; no explicit rank or post-inversion finiteness check appears here.
Pseudoinverse and regularized/NaN-checking chooseInverse are distinct paths; the inspected Tsls calls use direct inverse.

limitations: Static inspection of four pinned source files; no downloaded code, native package, caller or test was executed.
Tetrad latent measurement-model fitting is not evidence of generic external-IV or regression-discontinuity coverage.
Three zero-hit repository queries do not establish absence of Java/JVM alternatives or exhaustive coverage.
The source-level axis mismatch is not an observed package failure; caller reachability and concrete DataSet behavior remain unverified.
